facts.text: fancy/SimpleReacher-v0 is registered with entry point SimpleReacherEnv and n_links=2
The action space is a Box with one torque per link, low=-1000 and high=+1000 (max_torque 1000)
A step adds dt times the torque to the angular velocity and then dt times the angular velocity to the joint angle
The torque step returns terminated False and truncated False: the environment class has no terminal state
The distance reward starts at step 199 (steps_before_reward=199)
The reward is the distance term minus the sum of the squared torques; the distance term is zero before steps_before_reward
The observation concatenates cos(angle), sin(angle), angular velocity, end-effector minus goal and the step count
The observation space bounds the cos and sin components by +-pi and the velocity, target-distance and step components by infinity
A reset with random_start samples the first joint angle uniformly between pi/4 and 3*pi/4 and sets the other joints to zero
SimpleReacherEnv.reset generates a goal, resets, generates the goal again and resets again so a seeded reset is deterministic
The goal is drawn uniformly from a square of side 2*total_length until its norm is below total_length
A joint angle outside the joint limits is reported as a self collision

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 fixes the initial joint angle and the goal, and the dynamics are deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; this package's fake draws with Python's random.Random and upstream with numpy's generator, so a seed gives different trajectories on the two

gaps: kinematic point links integrated from torque: no link inertias, gravity, friction, contact forces or actuator dynamics; a collision only sets a flag and does not change the motion
the self collision check of the fake only tests the joint limits, not the segment intersections of base_reacher.py:114-118
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms (dt 0.01 s) only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one

the fake backend re-implements the kinematics in pure Python floats and was not compared with the upstream environment (fancy_gym was not importable where the gate ran): trajectories can differ from upstream's float32 observations and numpy random stream
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
the 200-step episode limit comes from the registration and the gymnasium TimeLimit wrapper, not from SimpleReacherEnv itself

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
